label: 移動
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame in-place HOVER movement of リリス EXACT 2x2. Body root y=550,535,550,565, torso leans left 10 degrees, wing tips beat up/neutral/down/neutral by 35px. Hair/cape follows 15px right. Smooth 4->1.  Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 翼を上げ下げし、髪と裾が追従する浮遊4コマ。
issues: 翼の幅と髪の量がコマ間で変わる。胴体と翼根を固定し4→1を合わせる。
翼端と裾の余白が少ない。移動の傾き・浮遊上下と待機の姿勢差を確認する。
